summary: Journal or mood log that stays on the device with no AI and an app lock, and keeps entries safe with user-controlled backup and restore after a device change.

evidence.claim: 8 dated complaints (2026-07 to 2026-11) about entries disappearing, sync stopping and no restore after a phone change, across 4 apps (Journal by Apple, Day One, Daylio, Stoic)
evidence.source: state/scout/2026-11-17-lifestyle.json (lifestyle-j2; each quote has an Apple review RSS URL and date)

evidence.claim: 8 dated complaints (2026-05 to 2026-11) about forced or unwanted AI, no app lock, and cloud storage in a journal, across 4 apps (Day One, Daylio, Stoic, DailyBean)
evidence.source: state/scout/2026-11-17-lifestyle.json (lifestyle-j1; each quote has an Apple review RSS URL and date)

scores.note: merged from scout candidates j1 and j2 (same core job: journal). Journaling is crowded (Day One, Apple Journal, Daylio). Some Day One users praise the AI, so the no-AI group size is unknown. Cause of data loss (sync, update, user error) unverified. Avoid mental-health claims.

history.note: kept: 16 complaints across two clusters, 5 apps; j1 and j2 merged
